responsibility: This autogenerated URL-mapping file is the documentation companion to c6x.opt, associating each user-visible C6X target option with the HTML manual anchor for that option when such documentation exists. It belongs to GCC’s generated option metadata rather than code generation, providing per-option UrlSuffix entries for flags like endianness selection, simulator mode, and -march so tooling around the option parser can connect C6X option definitions to the manual.
